SEASON 2 · GALACTIC CREATION
EMPIRE
ARENA

Real-time tactical combat practice. Capture light relays, link with your allies, defend your Core and win by objectives. This is an actual playable offline training simulation, not ranked multiplayer.

Protection: No account login, no real PvP opponent, no BP, QMP or Diamond rewards, no persistent items and no permanent deductions. AI opponents are explicitly training bots.
Controls: WASD/arrows to move; SPACE or Attack to strike; 1 skill, 2 dash, 3 ultimate, 4 Link, 5 barrier, 6 Guard. Touch joystick and buttons work on mobile. Attack approaches and strikes an opponent in range. Hold Attack for repeat strikes. Skills differ by character role; ultimates cost team Flux. Practice pickups give temporary health, shield or Flux. Sprites are training placeholders, not thirteen distinct finished rigs.
